title: Introducing Spyglass: Enhanced Insights for Everyone
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, moving beyond beta to provide all users with powerful new capabilities and clearer, actionable insights.

title: Take Control of Your Files in the Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage your images and files directly within the editor with powerful new tools that let you easily upload, download, remove, and customize how they appear.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We're excited to launch our new public roadmap, providing a clear overview of our progress and what's next for Noeko.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: Enjoy smoother task organization with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now easier to click, drag, and seamlessly integrated into your workspace.

title: Seamless Team Collaboration
summary: We've made teamwork in the editor more intuitive and delightful, ensuring everyone stays perfectly in sync and aware of shared progress.

title: Seamless Shared Item Access & Collaboration
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, now with enhanced visibility for all your relevant items.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with full transparency and direct involvement in shaping the project's future.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: We are thrilled to empower users worldwide by introducing comprehensive support for a multitude of international languages.

title: New and Enhanced Themes
summary: We're giving our existing themes a beautiful overhaul and introducing a vibrant collection of new styles to personalize your experience.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Exploration
summary: Elevate your understanding and collaboration by transforming your knowledge map into a dynamic hub, offering powerful new ways to filter, organize, and share your insights.

title: Refined Search & Custom Collections
summary: Take control of your knowledge with powerful new filtering options and the ability to save custom search views for instant access to your most relevant information.

title: Flexible Content Views
summary: Transform how you connect and visualize your notes, ideas, and tasks with dynamic new display options designed to streamline your thinking and workflow.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting & Premium Plans
summary: Experience ultimate flexibility and unlock advanced capabilities with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting options and integrated paid plans.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: Enjoy a more accurate and thoughtful welcome on your homepage, as we refine our greetings to match the exact time of your visit.

title: Supercharge Your Tag Management
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage your tagged content with powerful new bulk actions, allowing you to quickly unapply tags, delete items, or view details directly from any tag list.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: We're dramatically expanding the types of content you can integrate and interact with, letting you easily bring in insights from YouTube videos, websites, and various text formats for a truly unified research experience.
